title: Lentiviral transduction of iPSCs
author: Ruilin Tian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8dfhs3n
materials: Warm Trans IT-Lenti Reagent to Room temperature .

steps.title: Seed 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Seed 293T cells into a 6 well plate or other format 18–24 hours before transfection.

substeps.instruction: Ensure seeding density will result in 80–95% confluency on the day of transfection.
Incubate overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Complexes
steps.instruction: Prepare the Trans IT-Lenti:DNA complex mixture using Opti-MEM, DNA, and packaging mix.

substeps.instruction: Add Opti-MEM into a sterile tube.
Mix Packaging DNA Premix and DNA in a separate tube.
Add the DNA mix to the Opti-MEM and mix gently.
Add Trans IT-Lenti Reagent to the mixture and mix gently.
Incubate for 10 minutes to allow transfection complexes to form.

steps.title: Transfect 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Add the Trans IT-Lenti:DNA complex mixture to the 293T cells dropwise and gently swirl to mix.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 2 days.
Optional: If a fluorescent marker is included, check for fluorescence after 24 hours to verify virus production.

steps.title: Harvest and Filter Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect and filter the viral supernatant using a 12 ml syringe.

substeps.instruction: Take up the media/supernatant of the cells with the syringe.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 μm filter into a fresh 15 ml conical tube.
Change the filter if it becomes hard to push; avoid pushing too hard to prevent bubbles.

steps.title: Concentrate Virus
steps.instruction: Precipitate and pellet the virus from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add cold viral precipitation solution at a 1:4 ratio (e.g., 0.25 mL solution per 1 mL supernatant).
Incubate the viral supernatant at 4 °C for at least 4 hours and up to 3 days.
Cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.
Spin down the viral supernatant for 30 minutes at 1500 x g.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Virus
steps.instruction: Resuspend the viral pellet and store as needed.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet with 1 mL of the chosen media.
Aliquots can be stored at 4 °C for short term (a few days) or -80 °C for long term.
Optional: Flash freeze virus particles in liquid nitrogen to increase potency retention.

steps.title: Transduce iPSCs
steps.instruction: Seed iPSC cells so they reach 50% confluency the next day, then add the virus.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the virus gently before use.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 10x.
Add virus to cells (typically 1/4 or 1/2 of the total produced virus is sufficient).

steps.title: Verify Transduction and Select Cells
steps.instruction: Verify transduction efficiency and perform selection if applicable.

substeps.instruction: Check for fluorescence by microscopy the next day.
Check transduction efficiency by flow cytometry during the next passage.
For sgRNA constructs with puromycin resistance, add 0.8 ug/ml puromycin to select for cells until they are at least 80% confluent (typically within 2 passages).
